name: Tavelo ARDEN
why_interesting: A light all-road race frameset with UDH, threaded BSA and unusually broad 34 mm dual-ring or 38 mm single-ring clearance.
missing: Current mainland frameset price, stock and purchase route
Numeric geometry and exact size-to-weight mapping

facts.frame: Toray Race carbon; UDH; 12×100 / 12×142 mm thru axles
facts.sizes: Official frame-weight basis is size L
facts.cockpit: Frameset listing includes fork and seatpost; cockpit configuration varies

observed_price.price_basis: domestic launch report range for ARDEN Race and SL framesets without cockpit

price_status: launch-report branch range; exact Race versus SL package must be selected
support_note: Official policy states lifetime frameset coverage for the original purchaser through official or authorized channels; serial and receipt are required, and paint/decals are covered for one year.
source_note: Official weights are 780±25 g frame, 355 g fork and 115 g seatpost, excluding paint and accessories. The 38 mm maximum requires 1×; 2× is limited to 34 mm. The ¥9,999–12,999 range spans Race and SL launch packages without cockpit, so it is not one interchangeable SKU.
